title: Random Cozy Musics
description:
This addon adds custom music discs to the game.

It adds so many (32, but in future may reach up to 255 discs probably) discs to Minecraft.

Doesn't needs any library, needs Minecraft 26.1.2 NeoForge to work.
body:
16 JUNE - 26.2 1.1 ALPHA UPDATE IS COMING SOON

### Random Cozy Musics

![Discs (the one with Vertical Slabs not included, it's just an example)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f5c3ea75b1636daaafe04f3f43f234d589924e6.png)

**_All authors are credited in discs!!_**

~~Request musics, songs in comments! NSFW Musics/Songs aren't supported and should be compatible with Modrinth's [Content Rules!!](https://modrinth.com/legal/rules)~~
